notes.title: UPDATE #100
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40705060/07b25d8a5fe80638d2d9e076c6198a2d5f95c6b5.png

🆕 New PvE Mode — Survival
• The first PvE mode based on a wave system  
• Survive 8 waves of robots — each wave is stronger than the last  
• The more waves you survive, the higher your chance of getting a cosmetic TechBox  
• No AI teammates — only real players  
• The number of bosses scales with the number of players  
• Players can revive allies after they're taken down  

🎨 Texture Overhaul
• All textures have been updated  
• All types of lighting textures are now active — object surfaces appear more volumetric  
• Improved texture quality with no performance loss  

💥 New Visual Effects
• Added slow snowfall to the Ice Moon map  
• Weapon overheating now visually appears on the weapon itself  
• Robot destruction now features a powerful explosion  

🔫 Weapon Balancing
Laser:  
• Increased projectile speed  

Rocket Launcher:  
• Increased fire rate  
• Reduced damage  

Plasma:  
• Increased damage  
• Reduced fire rate  

⚙️ Gameplay Changes
• IR Flares can now explode any projectiles passing through them in mid-air  
• New accessibility setting: high-contrast text mode  
• Increased match start countdown (players didn’t have time to load)  
• Increased loadout selection time in round-based modes  
• Increased projectile size for most weapons — easier to see and hit  
• Electro-smoke now damages teammates  
• Electro-smoke overall damage reduced  
• Players joining round-based modes won't spawn mid-round anymore  
• Danger zone now deals more damage but moves slower  
• Small chance to get a TechBox at the end of any match — higher chance for the winning team  
• More aerial path variation for Drone AI  
• Default max player count is once again 8  
• Flashlight removed  
• AI sight significantly improved — they no longer lose targets easily when turning  
• AI pathfinding improved on urban maps — fewer chances of getting stuck, especially near big buildings  
• TechSphere Mine now triggers by radius, not side lasers  
• Increased TechSphere Mine damage  
• Robots with low HP now ignite and lose health over time unless healed  

🐞 Fixes
• Fixed random crashes when loading levels on Android  
• Fixed FPS drops on the Egypt map when Holiday/Halloween props were present  
• Some physics objects could pass through cars, rocks, and icebergs  
• Game mode could still repeat twice with random mode selection  
• Matchmaking considered ranked MMR even in unranked matches  
• Overheated weapons on client side could fail to fire after cooling  
• Drone AI couldn’t descend low enough to use flamethrower  
• Turret owner name and health didn’t display correctly for some clients  
• Rare desync of AI positions between clients  
• Deployed TechSpheres sometimes didn’t take damage  
• Mine explosion could fail to deal damage  
• Weapon overheating didn’t work properly in VR

notes.title: UPDATE #99.4

Changed

Fixed

 Weapon cooling rate has been doubled

 Laser pointers sometimes disappeared when playing in VR

notes.title: UPDATE #99
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40705060/0971f07993e817c7f015ae61b1664c98ac7082c0.png

Fixed

 Fixed an issue where the Gear would slow down in the air
 Axel had trouble clinging to a huge cross-shaped building on the Tokyo map
 Sometimes the energy was split if you used 2 grenade launchers
 The game menu broke when the player accepted the invitation without starting the game
 If you forcibly close the game (like alt+f4), a temporary penalty could be applied


Changed

 Removed camera tilts when turning and moving robots
 Now AI near will fire from the hip when it finds an enemy, rather than aiming and slowing itself down
 Increased air control for all robots
 Remaining damage that was not absorbed by armor now takes away health
 Increased FOV adjustment range
 Improved quality of visual effects


Balance change

 Health is again different for all robots
 Slightly increased the speed of all robots
 Full rebalance of all weapons
 Reduced the speed of projectiles for the Rocket Launcher, Railgun and Laser
 Increased flamethrower range


Shooting rework

 Shooting is now done directly from the camera when playing in first person
 This allows you to have complete control over the projectile, especially if you are shooting ahead at the enemy
 First person weapon placement has also been changed to better suit the new shooting mechanics
 The new weapon placement is also useful when using large FOV values, since the weapon now does not block visibility to the sides
 The healing beam also deals damage only in the center of the screen, “sticking” to surfaces has been removed
 The robot and weapon states have been returned to the screen interface when playing in first person


Weapon overclocking

 Overclocking has replaced weapon upgrades
 With overclocking you can change any weapon characteristics
 Overcharges have also been disabled and are awaiting immediate processing
 For all current upgrades, you will receive botcoins back to your game balance


Energy system rework

 Weapons now use overheat mechanics instead of energy consumption
 This means that now if a weapon is allowed to completely overheat, it will not be possible to use it until it cools down completely


Lobby system rework

 A new method for connecting friends to games minimizes the possibility of disconnection
 The time required to start the game has been reduced, as the connection speed has also been accelerated

notes.title: UPDATE #97

Ray Tracing and RTX Global Illumination support

 Significantly improved shadows that "soften" with distance from the light source
 Improves reflections that are not limited by screen space
 Improved shading between objects where they touch each other
 Surrounding geometry directly affects lighting

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40705060/7251733323e25532c87088dc31b1289e8c9f0abf.png

NVIDIA DLSS 3 support

 This technology significantly improves performance by upscaling images using AI
 Useful when used with Ray Tracing, can also work without it
 Your video card must also support this technology to use it.

Overcharge
